text: Contingent capital could create a regime for providing countercyclical regulatory capital that further enhances the regulatory capital requirements of the Federal Reserve and those under Basel III.
citation: Kaal, Dynamic Regulation via Contingent Capital (2017). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2957645
abstract: Accordingly, contingent capital could create a regime for providing countercyclical regulatory capital51 that further enhances regulatory capital requirements of the Federal Reserve52 and under Basel III.53
